description: Class registry - see CLAUDE.md's Class Items section for authoring guidelines.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage. Barbarians are unmatched in raw physical power and durability.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation. Bards are versatile spellcasters and skilled performers who support allies and hinder foes.

classes.name: Chronomancer
classes.description: A master of temporal manipulation who can rewind time, slow enemies, and glimpse possible futures. Chronomancers perceive time as fluid and bend it to their will.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power. Clerics combine healing, support, and combat abilities.

classes.name: Dreamweaver
classes.description: A master of dreams, illusions, and the subconscious mind. Dreamweavers can enter dreamscapes, create convincing illusions that border on reality, and manipulate the sleeping and waking mind alike.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor. Fighters are versatile warriors who excel in melee and ranged combat.

classes.name: Gene Splicer
classes.description: A bio-engineer who manipulates genetics and biology at the molecular level. Gene Splicers can grant mutations, enhance physical abilities, and reshape living tissue with terrifying precision.

classes.name: Gunslinger
classes.description: A master of firearms who can pull off impossible shots with preternatural accuracy. Gunslingers are deadly at range, combining quick reflexes with steady nerves and uncanny marksmanship.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection. Monks are deadly unarmed combatants.

classes.name: Necrotech
classes.description: A fusion of necromancy and technology, creating undead enhanced with cybernetic implants. Necrotechs blur the line between life and death, machine and flesh, commanding armies of cybernetic zombies.

classes.name: Netrunner
classes.description: A cyberpunk hacker who infiltrates digital networks, breaks ICE defenses, and wages war in cyberspace. Netrunners can jack into any system and bend it to their will.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath. Paladins combine martial prowess with divine magic to smite evil and protect the innocent.

classes.name: Psi-Knight
classes.description: A psychic warrior who combines mental powers with martial prowess. Psi-Knights use telekinesis, telepathy, and psionic energy to enhance their combat abilities and devastate enemies with mind over matter.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization. Rangers are skilled hunters and trackers.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies. Rogues rely on skill, stealth, and their foes' vulnerabilities to get the upper hand.

classes.name: Runesmith
classes.description: An inscriber of magical runes who channels power through ancient symbols. Runesmiths etch mystical glyphs onto objects, surfaces, and even their own bodies to create powerful enchantments and devastating effects.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline. Sorcerers wield raw, chaotic magical power with innate talent rather than study.

classes.name: Stormcaller
classes.description: A conduit for elemental fury who commands wind, rain, and lightning. Stormcallers are living tempests, channeling the raw power of nature's most devastating weather phenomena.

classes.name: Void Touched
classes.description: One who has gazed into the void beyond reality and returned changed. Void Touched wield eldritch powers that warp space, bend minds, and tear at the fabric of existence itself.

classes.name: Roadwarden
classes.description: A long-haul driver turned wandering guardian, unstoppable once they get moving. Roadwardens barrel through anything that isn't nailed down and shrug off exhaustion that would fell lesser travelers.

classes.name: Emberguard
classes.description: A firefighter who never learned to walk away from danger. Emberguards charge into burning buildings, collapsing structures, and worse, dragging the helpless out ahead of the flames.

classes.name: Field Surgeon
classes.description: A battlefield trauma doctor with a scalpel's precision and a stopwatch's urgency. Field Surgeons know exactly where to cut to hurt and exactly where to press to heal.

classes.name: Auditor
classes.description: A meticulous examiner who treats every enemy like a ledger full of hidden errors. Auditors find the flaw in any defense and make sure the cost of missing it compounds.

classes.name: Barkeep
classes.description: A tavern keeper who's seen every kind of trouble walk through the door and knows how to talk it back out again. Barkeeps read a room in an instant and pour exactly what's needed to keep the peace - or win the fight.

classes.name: Newshound
classes.description: A relentless investigator who can't leave a story unfinished. Newshounds dig up the secret nobody wanted found and know exactly how to make it count once it's out.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: A battlefield coordinator with the calm, all-seeing focus of someone who's talked a hundred flights safely to the ground. Dispatchers rarely swing a weapon themselves, choosing instead to put every ally exactly where they need to be.

classes.name: Deep Driller
classes.description: A career miner who's spent more time underground than under the sun. Deep Drillers can find the weak point in any wall, vein, or foe, and the dark holds no fear for them.

classes.name: Culinarian
classes.description: A chef whose knife work is as sharp on the battlefield as it is in the kitchen. Culinarians keep the whole party fed, fueled, and fighting at their best.

classes.name: Claims Warden
classes.description: A risk assessor who's read every disaster report and decided to start intercepting the disasters personally. Claims Wardens step between their allies and harm, then find the technicality that makes the damage someone else's problem.

classes.name: Child Star
classes.description: A prodigy who's been in the spotlight since before they could walk unassisted. Child Stars burn brighter than anyone else in the room, and demand - loudly - the chance to do it all again if it isn't perfect the first time.

classes.name: Influencer
classes.description: A charismatic self-promoter who has never once forgotten they might be being watched. Influencers thrive in the spotlight and visibly wilt the moment nobody's paying attention.

classes.name: President
classes.description: An elected (or self-appointed) leader who commands a room the way they command a nation. Presidents rally their people with a word and never go anywhere without protection.

classes.name: Sentai Hero
classes.description: A costumed champion who fights best as part of a team, striking dramatic poses between devastating blows. Sentai Heroes hit harder for every ally at their side, though their flashy transformations leave them briefly exposed.

classes.name: Card Duelist
classes.description: A strategist who fights through a bond with a spectral creature summoned from their deck. Card Duelists trust as much in the turn of fate as they do in their own skill.

classes.name: Redditor
classes.description: A self-appointed expert on absolutely everything, ready with an unsolicited correction at a moment's notice. Redditors thrive on being right - or at least sounding like it - and grow more confident with every point they score.

classes.name: Oracle
classes.description: A seer who speaks in riddles and sees the threads of fate before they're pulled. Oracles glimpse danger a heartbeat before it arrives and can occasionally talk death itself into waiting a little longer.

classes.name: Reality Star
classes.description: A drama magnet who's never met a conflict they didn't lean into for the cameras. Reality Stars thrive on confrontation and forge alliances as easily as they break them.

classes.name: Pirate Captain
classes.description: A charismatic outlaw of the high seas who leads through fear, charm, and the promise of plunder. Pirate Captains rally their crew with a shout and always seem to know exactly where the good loot is buried.

classes.name: Trickster
classes.description: A shapeshifting figure of myth who delights in chaos, illusion, and getting the last laugh. Tricksters slip out of danger by leaving a decoy behind and can talk their way into - or out of - almost anything.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality through arcane study and practice. Wizards are masters of spellcasting.
